title: Prove a sharp all-axis obstruction to Gaussian rounding tensor consistency (no new κ)
body:
For N=2^n, n>=1, prove that global Gaussian-unit covariance and exactness on integral ideal outputs force an explicit row/column discrepancy for every integer-valued native rounder. The rank-one defect identity gives the sharp Frobenius floor sqrt(N), without bijectivity or error assumptions.

If F(e0) is nonzero, the sharp squared floor is 2N-2^(floor(n/2)+1). A conservative bijection attains it, with proved unbounded error and native-square failure. The separately pinned four-axis package now resolves bounded-error, exact-square attainment at n=4; other dimensions and additional contracts remain open here. These are fixed-witness bounds.

Base: 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a.
Predecessor #6509: a4173e810c4d34a1d13b9745af123ad0ec6cfed5.
Its concrete example motivates the question; the new all-n proof is self-contained.
Proof SHA256: 8d5480e061b9ec00b5d9bbcf6d1c6945857606814efd526ddf4c3d2c72ec81ec.
Exact predecessor/companion pins: SOURCES.json.

Reproduce (Python 3.12, stdlib):
```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/gaussian-rounding-tensor-obstruction
```
Expected: `PASS_GAUSSIAN_ROUNDING_TENSOR_OBSTRUCTION` and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

Executed: exact tensor identities n=0..6; twelve nonlinear fiber fixtures, 84 phase and 56 integral-image cases, a 258-bit fixture, both sharp attaining maps and seven hypothesis/phase controls. Separate written review checked the universal argument and boundaries. Normal/-O, metadata, committed bytes/modes and Git-free replay pass. Finite checks do not replace the all-n proof; no failed-search inference.

No new κ. The same stateless map acts on every row and column. Stateful/enlarged representations or distinct maps are outside scope. Actual-caller applicability and a complete paid replacement interface remain open; this is not a counterexample to the selected theorem. All five selected assumptions remain.

By @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separately assigned mathematical review. Credit Ali Romman (#6509) and the companion four-axis investigation. No human/proof-kernel acceptance.

Proof, exact checker and limits: https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/f711bd201a037ba6a7e3fed72d00bfcbf4f0420a/research/gaussian-rounding-tensor-obstruction
Complete remote Git tree matches the tested contribution.
